# NaufalRF Anonymous Message App

> Anonymous message surface for the portfolio ecosystem. This app lets visitors send feedback or questions without revealing identity, while still enforcing CAPTCHA and routing all persistence through Admin APIs.

## What this app does

- Renders the anonymous-message page.
- Validates submissions with Turnstile before sending them onward.
- Uses same-origin analytics proxying for pageviews and submission-related events.
- Delegates message persistence entirely to Admin public APIs.

## Important behavior

- This app is API-only; it never writes directly to the database.
- Turnstile stays visually hidden until the user starts typing.
- Submission is blocked when CAPTCHA is unavailable; it does not silently bypass validation.
- The page is intentionally simple and focused on safe anonymous delivery.

## Key routes

- [/](https://ngl.naufalrf.tech/) - anonymous message form
- [/api/analytics](https://ngl.naufalrf.tech/api/analytics) - same-origin analytics proxy
